annotation.unknown_reason: The obligations require determining the channel with the smallest number of messages and identifying which users are not already in that channel, then asserting their membership in that channel. The initial state provides message counts per channel and user-channel memberships, but does not specify which channel is the least-message channel in a way that can be referenced in a post-state clause without resolving the expected channel name. The obligations also require post-state membership for users not already in that channel, which cannot be derived without disclosing the resolved channel and user set. Therefore, the required POST-condition cannot be constructed without leaking the resolved values, which is not permitted in this scope.
